notes.title: Achievements, Music and Emotes — Update 29/12/2019
notes.notes:
Survivors!

Long time no see! This is the last update for Pandemic Express this year, but not the last one ever.

Today we're introducing achievements, new emotes and music to the game, and we'll kick off the next year with some more exciting changes, so stay tuned!


Here's the full list of changes:

sys_version = 1.0.0.0.030 19/10/29


 Added Steam achievements
 Music tracks are now purchasable with stars
 
 Music can be played on the station radios
 You can equip up to 3 tracks into a match
 Total of 30 tracks is available

https://i.ibb.co/gtmwvQj/music.gif
Added special emotes, purchasable with stars
https://i.imgur.com/vGlLaUO.gif
 [Map] Fixes to the cable car location: removed objects that were interfering with climbing up the ladder



See you in 2020!

notes.title: 1.0 Release / 1+1 Promo — 27/09/2019
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/6pVrYS5.gif

Hey everyone!

Today we're launching Pandemic Express 1.0, we’re finally out of Early Access. We wanted to thank you, our community, for sticking with us throughout this journey, and helping us make the game better.

To celebrate, we're once again launching a special offer:

Everyone who buys Pandemic Express within the first 7 days gets an additional copy to give to a friend! And this time around you can play with your friends.

Since the launch of Early Access we’ve implemented many features and gameplay changes. Take a look at the roadmap presented back in May, and stay tuned for a new one!

https://i.imgur.com/h3z5u0P.png



And finally, here are the patch notes for v.1.0.0.0.000. Since we wanted the launch to be as smooth as possible, it’s nothing major — all the drastic changes were delivered in the last couple of updates.


 New Cable Car model
 New Cable Car supporting mount model
 Fixed healing on the train
 Patched the holes on a station
 Increased Zombie speed for the first 30% of the overall lobby population




Grab a friend, jump into a lobby, spam some “Hello”s and never stop running!

Yours, Tallboys and tinyBuild team

notes.title: Update 14/08/2019
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34325804/570ec9a5d2ff38b8b13dbf4e23fd5af24465d8d0.jpg

Hey everyone! Here's the full list of changes in the latest update:


v..0.9.4.000 19/08/14



 A tutorial has been added to the warm-up map. The tutorial will be offered to players who have played less than 5 matches.
Developer Comment:  For now we have implemented a tutorial for basic mechanics: double jumping, sliding and simple gunjumping. In future updates we will expand the tutorial, offering more complex mechanics.

 Added item store system. Set of Doubts and Mask of Vanity are available for purchase. Sets can be purchased for stars, received after a match. 
Developer Comment: We want to give a better sense of progression and growth in the game. All future sets will be obtainable using the same system.

 There will be a temporary wipe of all points and levels.  This is temporary.
Developer Comment: In the coming days, we will convert all the old values into the new system that will preserve all the current progression.  This change is necessary since in the new system some statistics conflict with the old ones.

 The endgame screen has been changed.  Added accounting for the new points system. Changed the rating system.
Developer Comment: Stars are shown on the new screen - Game Currency.  The score of the players and the stars are working in test mode and will change during the balancing process.

Table of values for the new system:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34325804/325606c78cd2d37c1e6eacb0d6af04c6f2194319.jpg

 Reduced the number of points received from the damage dealt to a Conductor.
Developer Comment: This is a temporary solution introduced in order to reduce points farming on several conductors. In the future we plan to revise the Conductor itself and fix the bug with their number.

 Fixed a bug where the extra heart perk of the Rebellion Set disappeared.

Mimic names are now taken from the list of human players’ names in the match

New points system
Developer Comment: The system is now in test mode and will be updated for balancing in the coming days.  The main task is to equalize the number of points received per match for zombies and for humans.

notes.title: Reworked Bomber, Balancing Changes — 21/06/2019
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/BlUnveI.gif

Hey everyone! 

Second update of the week promises to make the games more chaotic and more fun for zombies, as well as make it more difficult for a solo survivor to win. Reworked Bomber is back, their friend Phantom is on vacation, but they'll be back soon enough!

Please find the patch notes below, and as always, and don't forget to restart your Steam client if you didn't get the update automatically!

0.8.7.000 19/06/21

 Added the ability to choose a zombie class without the need to fill the bar. Available at any point of the game in the spawn mode.

Bomber is back

 Bomber's health is ⅓ of a heart.
 Bomber can hit humans by pressing LMB, damaging them for ⅓ of a heart.
 Bomber explodes only upon dying. The explosion is instant.
 Bomber's explosion deals 2, 1⅓ or ⅔  hearts damage, depending on proximity, and causes negative visual effects.
 Bomber can throw smoke grenades. Cooldown — 5 seconds, duration — 5 seconds, radius - 10 meters.
 Bomber leaves a smoke cloud upon dying.
 Bomber can't be knocked back.

 Mimic changes

Previously planted bombs explode upon entering the spawn mode.
 Fixed the kamikaze™ bug where Mimics could plant bombs in the air.

 Phantom is on vacation (rework)
 Removed the damage increase system — now humans' damage doesn't increase when the number of humans goes down
 Reduced melee damage with weapons
 Reduced knock back radius. Automatic weapons — 5 meters, rest of the weapons — 7-15 meters.
 Tightened shotgun spread


Good luck!

Please find the patch notes below, and don't forget to restart your Steam client if you didn't get the update automatically!

v..0.8.5.000 19/06/13

Mimic rework:

- Mimic can now plant bombs — press Q to activate
- Mimic can hit as normally by pressing LMB
- Mimic can plant up to 3 bombs, planting a bomb after that will cause the oldest one to de-spawn
- Bombs look like armor jars
- Bombs are triggered by humans in proximity of 4 meters
- Blast radius is 8 meters
- Bombs can be deactivated by shooting at them
- Upon explosion, humans in the blast radius start to lose health, one heart per 6 seconds
- Humans can stop this damage by holding E

Conductor tweak:

- Increased health
- Added a 60 seconds Conductor transfer timer. After the time is up, the role is transferred to another player without the death penalty
- The timer can be refilled by doing damage or killing a human
- Conductor is now tagged for other zombies
- Conductor can no longer slide


- Humans can't shoot while opening a drop
- The safe zone now shrinks to the size of the train
- [Map] Tweaked a location next to the Station A


Have fun!

notes.title: Conductor Update — 07/06/2019
notes.notes:

Hey everyone!

It's been only a day since the last update, and we've already got another one for you!

This time we're introducing a new zombie class — the Conductor.

Conductor is a boss zombie that is given to one random zombie player when the humans are overpowering the zombies.

It's got a ton of health and can't be knocked back by bullets. When it dies, the role is given to another random zombie player, and so on until the situation is more even.

Please don't forget to restart your Steam client if you didn't receive the update automatically.

Here's the full patch note:

v..0.8.4.000 19/06/07


 Added Conductor zombies
 Fixed gun sounds


Have fun!

notes.title: 24/05/19 Update + Mimic Day Event!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34325804/067c533c904aae398dc5511a2390ad4a6ce3ed7c.png

Hey there! Sorry we weren't in touch lately.

The team is working relentlessly on making the core of the game even more enjoyable (more on that in later announcements) and adding more content.

And to keep they players happy in the meantime, we've decided to run a series of event.

First up is the Mimic Day, and here's how it works:


 All zombies look like humans
 First zombie (patient zero) is a mimic that can explode
 Regular zombies look like humans but can't explode, instead they hit like normally
 Upon hitting 100% on your zombie meter you can respawn as an exploding mimic


You can't trust anyone, especially in the early game, when humans don't have weapons. Should be fun!

The event starts right now and will last until Sunday, 19:00 CEST/13:00 EST/10:00 PST

Don't forget to restart your Steam client if you didn't receive the update automatically!

Apart from that, we have a pretty big update today, with various fixes and improvements. Here are the full patch notes:

 Overhauled weapon sounds

notes.title: Final Pre-Launch Patch, Pricing, 1+1 Promo
notes.notes:
https://imgur.com/GcnH2j5.gif

Hi everyone!

We're super excited to be launching Pandemic Express TOMORROW at 9:30am Pacific Time! 

Let's go ahead and run through everything that's happening tomorrow. 

Launch Trailer

Get an early peek at the Launch Trailer

https://youtu.be/VCb-Jd7pEDo

 Alpha Community Keeps The Game 

Everyone who helped playtest the game (activated their Alpha test) gets to keep the game. Forever. For free. 

Thanks for being part of the community and sharing your love and feedback early on. We really appreciate it <3

 1+1 Promotion 

If you haven't participated in the alpha tests — don't worry, we've got something for you as well!

To celebrate the launch, for the first 3 days, anyone who buys Pandemic Express on Steam gets an extra free copy to give to their friends. So go ahead and share the love!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34325804/6afbdbdf60bbcb04488d3d0f042286fec41a6dcc.png

Launch Price is under $10

The full MSRP for Pandemic Express will be $14.99, however we're launching with a 34% Launch Discount! 

Patch Notes

If last time you played the game was this Winter or even Fall of last year — there's too many changes to count. If were chasing the survivors just last weekend — here's the list of changes for this week:


v.0.7.9.4.190502
- Fixed sliding animations
- Fixed the bug with the safe zone train stops
- Fixed the main menu UI bugs
- Fixed the server status notification

v.0.7.9.3.190430
- New zombie look
- Major UI overhaul
    - New main menu
    - New match end screens
    - New airdrop UI
    - Changed the color corresponding to health
    - Added armor pickup sign
- Fixed freezes that occurred while connecting to a lobby

The Road Ahead

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34325804/229086c768b3c049b7de0397a8a82586fc7e18b4.png

We've got big plans for the game. You can find the roadmap  above, but we'd like to address three major community requests separately.

1) Regional servers
As of right now, the game's servers are located in Germany. This means that players from the Asia-Pacific region, South America and West Coast of the US might experience latency issues.

We will be closely monitoring the player count in every region, and as soon as we see that regional servers are a viable option, we'll start working on implementing them ASAP. 

2) Playing with your friends
This is one of the most frequently requested features, it will be added into the game soon. For now — hit "Play" at the same time as your friends, and you should end up in the same lobby.

3) Control rebinds
Another very important for a competitive game feature. We know it can be a pain, especially if you've used your custom keybinds for years. We'll work on implementing it as soon as we can, but it may take a little longer than the first two.
